lines.text: Almeda Genoa Road. The lot's closed, and the lamps are still on.
Evening. Lot's closed, but the lamps stay on a while.
If you're after the man in the green suit, he's by the showroom.
Rain's the only customer that never haggles.
Go on. Mind the puddles. They're deeper than they look.
Tonight I do. I lock the gate and keep the rain off the windshields.
Mostly the rain wins.
Nobody's expecting anybody this late. Go say hello.
Showroom's that way. Follow the lamps.
This gate and I have an understanding. It doesn't move, and neither do I.
Well, look at that. Thank you. Go on in before you drown.
Clear vehicles. Clear terms. Real people. Somebody painted that and meant it.
A board of sold tags by the door. Somebody keeps count.
Rain beads on the hood like it was waxed this afternoon.
The lamps hang upside down in the puddles, waiting for somebody to step on them.
Hi. I'm fictional, before you ask. So are my numbers.
Still fictional. Still happy with the deal.
Signed. That was quick. Thank you, fictionally.
Least painful thing that's happened to me all week.
Thanks for calling Triple J Auto. How can I help?
Hi. Is the gray truck on your site still there? Could I come see it Saturday?
It's still here. I can book you for Saturday morning. What's your name?
Marcus.
You're all booked, Marcus. See you Saturday.
One more thing. Can you hold the truck if I put money down tonight?
That's one for the team. Let me get someone for you.
Folders tabbed by hand. Form 130-U, webDEALER, liens, temp tags.
A data model in marker. Lead, deal, title. Three notes hang off it.
A lead from Facebook Marketplace, researched and waiting. The seller's labelled example.
A ledger, closed. The kind you keep even when the computer keeps it too.
An arcade cabinet. After Hours: The Run. Somebody turned a resume into a game.
The coffee machine ticks as it cools.
From in here the lot looks like a painting of itself.
The library will close soon. Please bring your books to the front desk.
The desk lamp hums. The rest of the floor has gone dark.
Morning. Dry asphalt. The lamps are off for once.
Thanks again for the gate. Get home safe.
